2026-09-28 (NEW since the 09-28 scan) — 3 bullets:
 1. Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) launched; Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Claude
    Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry.
 2. Five breaking changes vs Sonnet 5: thinking {"type":"between_tools"} replaces
    "disabled" at high effort or below; tool_choice any/tool returns 400; thinking blocks
    tied to model AND conversation; computer_20251124 not accepted on Claude API + Google
    Cloud; *** the ADVISOR TOOL rejects Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 5 as advisors. ***
 3. *** ACCOUNT-BOUND THINKING BLOCKS: thinking blocks Sonnet 5.5 produces "work only in
    the account that produced them, or in an account linked to it. When another account
    sends one of these blocks, the API DROPS THE BLOCK BEFORE THE MODEL SEES IT, AND THE
    REQUEST SUCCEEDS." Earlier models unaffected. Silent degradation, no error raised. ***
